title: WolOS revocation list, format 1 (ADR 0046, woltrust revoked.rs)
description: The signed bytes of revoked.json. The woltrust reader refuses unknown keys, so this schema does too. Unix seconds. expires = issued + 24 hours (woltrust rkdb::LIFETIME; the list is republished hourly).

serial.description: A certificate id (128 hex) or a 16-hex serial (a release statement, a certificate of before rule IDS).

reason.description: withdrawn-version: serial is a release statement's; only that version is withdrawn (written only when tools/woltrust.features has withdrawn-version).
